answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch however much capital it holds, as each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The jetty cap is checked at intake and zephyr shows the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a ripple tag. That is 24 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
